purpose: Throughput trial for maxAlphaCo=0.40 with eight alpha subcycles; not an event-classification result
reason: Global Courant already limited the step near 0.40, so raising maxAlphaCo gave almost no deltaT gain while doubling MULES work per step and reducing throughput.
notes: Per-subcycle interface Courant would have remained 0.05, but the trial was stopped for throughput, not accuracy.
Production retains the previously gated maxAlphaCo=0.20 / four-subcycle controls.
